name: Phantom Mansion II: Treasures of the Seven Seas - The Black Sea
summary: Argh, matey! Hector has returned. This time, he has found a treasure map and sets off for riches. Using the arrow keys the player must guide a character to go from room to room, solving the puzzle of each to get all the golden treasure skulls per room. The room can then be exited to tackle the next one. When encountering a locked door, a key with the same symbol as the door needs to be found. Avoid stepping into water as it will make the character drown. Crates can be used to make bridges or use a raft, if available. Use switches to open walls to reach all the treasure skulls.
